title: Proposed source-bound Qwen annotation contract (not active pilot input)
description: Semantic annotations are model hypotheses, not facts certified by schema validation. Raw source evidence remains separately available and unchanged.

mention_id.description: Unique observation ID, not entity identity.

entity_key.description: Task-local identity hypothesis. null if unresolved. Shared category never suffices for shared identity. Cross-name alias identity requires explicit source evidence.

category.description: Family/type annotation, NEVER a same-entity deduplication key.

relation.description: Relation relevant to the question, preserving direction and negation.

eligible.description: Qwen relevance hypothesis; null means unresolved, not false.

conditions.description: Necessary population, temporal, conditional and other scope restrictions.

support_status.description: Qwen judgment that still requires source checking.

quote.description: Exact contiguous substring in the identified original evidence. Validate mechanically; no stitched quote.
